For comfort, lean into qualitative patient feedback alongside data showing reduced side-effect profiles, framing the drug as gentle yet profoundly effective. Aggressively position this by contrasting our definitive relief against the prolonged suffering associated with generic alternatives.

That "Minutes, Not Hours" angle sounds killer for the TV spots. 

Quick question though—I was glancing at the raw clinical tables earlier and some of the side effect data looked a little messy. I saw some notes about increased nausea compared to the generic group. If we lead with that "maximum comfort" angle, are we going to run into trouble with the discomfort data?
